units.source_text: 移居之日，夕雾亲赴一条宫邸，派遣车辆及前驱人赴小野迎接。

en.t: On the day of the move, Yugiri went in person to the Ichijo residence and sent carriages and advance attendants to Ono to bring her back.
The princess declared that she would never return to the capital.
All the ladies in waiting pleaded with her earnestly.

units.source_text: 大和守也劝道：“公主此言，教人殊难奉命。

en.t: The Governor of Yamato also urged her, saying, "My lady, such words make it very difficult for us to obey you.

units.source_text: 卑人因见公主孤单悲苦，不胜同情，故竭尽绵力，为公主效劳。

en.t: Seeing Your Highness alone and sorrowful, I was overcome with sympathy, and so I have done all that my poor strength allowed in your service.

units.source_text: 今大和当地有事，必须赴任亲理。

en.t: Now matters have arisen in Yamato, and I must go to my post and attend to them myself.

units.source_text: 而此间一切事务，无人可以接任。

en.t: Yet here there is no one who can take over all these affairs.

units.source_text: 若不顾而去，则实甚怠慢。

en.t: If I were to leave without concern for them, it would truly be most negligent.

units.source_text: 正在左右为难之际，幸蒙夕雾大将关怀，如此竭诚照拂。

en.t: Just when I was at a loss what to do, General Yugiri kindly showed concern and has taken such devoted care of everything.

units.source_text: 公主认为此君存心不良，因而不肯屈尊，亦自有理。

en.t: Your Highness may think that this gentleman has improper intentions, and it is understandable that you do not wish to lower yourself.

units.source_text: 话虽如此，但自古以来，皇女迫不得已而下嫁者，其例甚多。

en.t: Even so, since ancient times there have been many cases of imperial princesses marrying beneath their rank because they had no other choice.

units.source_text: 世人不会教公主独任其咎。

en.t: People will not make Your Highness bear the blame alone.

units.source_text: 迟疑不决，反而显得幼稚。

en.t: To hesitate and remain undecided would only make you seem childish.

units.source_text: 即使欲坚持己志，但为女子者，要独力照顾自身，以求生涯安稳，岂可得乎！

en.t: Even if you wish to hold fast to your own will, how can a woman look after herself alone and hope for a secure life?

units.source_text: 毕竟还得有男人爱护照顾，仗此助力，才能发挥其慧心贤才。

en.t: In the end, only with a man's loving care and support can she bring out her wisdom and talents.

units.source_text: 左右诸人，都不知道以此大义劝导公主，只管自作自主，干那些不应有的事情。”

en.t: Those around you do not know how to guide Your Highness with this larger principle, and instead act on their own and do things they ought not do."

units.source_text: 又说了许多话，责备侍女左近及小少将君。

en.t: He went on at length, reproaching the ladies in waiting Sakon and Koshosho no Kimi.
